# ModuleScript

- Inherits [`BaseScript`](basescript.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ModuleScript")`

Luau code that is loaded with `require` instead of running on its own. The first `require(module)` runs the code once; every later `require` of the same instance returns the same value. Use it for code that several scripts share.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
